interface.title: GraphBin-Viz: Interactive Visual Analytics for Exploring Graph-based Metagenomic Binning
interface.stage_of_work: Refining and checking metagenomic bins after assembly and an initial binning tool, before using the bins downstream
interface.what_it_is_for: Runs GraphBin in the browser to refine an initial contig binning along the assembly graph, then lets the researcher see why each contig was placed where it was, correct contigs that look wrong, re-run the refinement and export the curated bins and plots.

data.note: I pressed 'Run example data', which loads the bundled SPAdes assembly graph (GFA), contigs, paths and an initial binning CSV: 519 contigs, 958 edges, 5 bins (test_bin_0, 1, 3, 4, 5). The first run took about a minute while Pyodide loaded, and the page stopped responding to screenshots for a while. I uploaded nothing. The review points out that the bundled public/data/graphbin_res.csv could have been uploaded as an 'Other binning result', but I did not try this, so the 'Other binning results' input stayed empty and every comparison covers only 2 results (Initial and GraphBin). Many screens were taken after the locked re-run (t13), so counts in them come from the curated run, not the first refinement.

features.name: Per-item decision provenance inspector
features.general: Pick an item to see why an algorithm put it in its group: how the decision was made, the label it rejected, the scores of competing groups, the neighbours whose evidence counted, and how far it is from trusted evidence. Then jump to a supporting neighbour or select all supporters.
features.specific: 'Why this assignment?' panel: decision stage (kept, inferred by propagation, label removed, locked by analyst), the rejected initial label, Confidence, Hops to seed, Labelled at iter, Label changes, assignment across results, competing-bin bars with margin and entropy, supporting contigs with weights, Select supporters in all views, adjacent bins, contig stats.
steps: click a contig in the Needs attention list or in the graph
read the decision stage, the rejected label and the confidence
compare the competing-bin bars
press Select supporters in all views, or click a supporting contig to inspect it
press Back to summary
serves_tasks: Open the reasoning behind one item's group assignment
Follow the evidence to the neighbours that support a decision

features.name: Triage summary with clickable breakdowns and a needs-attention list
features.general: A summary of an automatic run whose decision-type bars and confidence histogram can be clicked to select those items, plus a ranked list of items to review with a select-all.
features.specific: Refinement summary: Contigs, Bins, Seeds, Iterations; 'How each bin was decided' bars; Refinement confidence buckets (0-20% … 80-100%); Needs attention count with Select all/Deselect all and NODE rows tagged 'tools disagree', 'label removed' or 'low confidence'.
steps: read the counts and the confidence histogram
click a confidence bucket or a decision-stage bar to select those contigs in all views
press Select all for the contigs needing attention
click one listed contig to open its provenance
serves_tasks: Select the flagged items as a group
Open the reasoning behind one item's group assignment

features.name: Linked network and feature scatter with shared selection
features.general: A network view and a two-feature scatter of the same items. Brushing items in the scatter highlights them in the network; the scatter's axes can be changed and the panel enlarged.
features.specific: Assembly graph + Feature space: GC%, Coverage, Length or Confidence on either axis; box brush (lasso also offered); Maximise feature space (a pop-out to a new window is also offered); selection shared with the assembly graph; Clear selection.
steps: drag a box in the scatter to brush contigs
see them highlighted in the assembly graph
change the scatter axes (e.g. Length × Confidence)
press Maximise feature space, brush again, then restore
press Clear selection
serves_tasks: Move between network structure and measured features for a group of items

features.name: Before/after flow diagram with change filters
features.general: A Sankey of how items moved between groups from one result to another, with headline change counts and toggles to hide unchanged and ungrouped items, and click-to-select on any flow that highlights those items in the other views.
features.specific: Contig flow between results: Changed bin, Re-assigned, Newly binned and Unbinned tiles; Only changed and Hide unbinned checkboxes; click a flow to select those contigs in the assembly graph and feature scatter; it follows the propagation replay iteration and updates after a re-run.
steps: read the change counts
tick Only changed and Hide unbinned to leave only the bin-to-bin reassignments
click a flow band to select its contigs
look at where they sit in the graph and the scatter
serves_tasks: See how many items moved between groups and pick out one movement

features.name: Graph encoding and filter controls
features.general: Recolour and resize network nodes by different properties, filter to subsets (uncertain, disputed, one group, hide ungrouped or isolated), and overlay markers for changed, likely wrong or ambiguous items. The legend adapts to the encoding.
features.specific: Result (Initial/GraphBin); Colour by (Bin assignment, Refinement confidence, Cross-result disagreement, Decision stage, Coverage, GC, Length); Size by (Uniform, Contig length, Coverage, Degree); Show only bin; Node size slider; Show chips (Tools disagree, Low confidence, Hide unbinned, Hide isolated), which combine as AND; Mark chips (Changed by refinement, Likely misbinned, Ambiguous); Reset view.
steps: choose Colour by and Size by
toggle a Show filter such as Low confidence or Tools disagree
toggle a Mark overlay such as Likely misbinned or Changed by refinement
restrict to one bin with Show only bin
adjust Node size
serves_tasks: Narrow the network to the uncertain or disputed items
Focus the network on one group and scale items by a property
Switch the network view between the two results

features.name: Propagation replay with GIF export
features.general: Scrub or play through an iterative algorithm's steps on the network, with the linked views following, and save the animation.
features.specific: Propagation replay bar (GraphBin result only): Play/Pause, iteration slider (iter N … final), Speed (Very slow to Fast), Save GIF; the flow counts follow the iteration.
steps: set Result = GraphBin to enable the replay
drag the slider to an early iteration
press Play and watch labels spread
press Save GIF
serves_tasks: Step through how labels spread over the iterations

features.name: Lock-and-rerun curation
features.general: Assign the selected items to a chosen group as fixed constraints, re-run the algorithm with those constraints, and export the corrected result.
features.specific: Curate panel: Assign selected to (bin), Lock assignment (shows 'N locked: bin ×N'; acts on the current selection, not the contig open in the inspector), Clear locks, Re-run refinement (locked contigs become fixed seeds; the inspector shows 'Locked by analyst'), Export binning (CSV).
steps: select the contig(s) in the graph, scatter or flow
choose the target bin in Assign selected to
press Lock assignment
press Re-run refinement and check the inspector and flow counts
press Export binning
serves_tasks: Fix an item to the correct group and recompute
Export the curated grouping, the raw outputs and a figure

features.name: Static before/after plots with plot settings and download
features.general: Render the network coloured by the grouping before and after refinement as side-by-side static figures, sized and formatted from settings chosen before the run, each with its own download.
features.specific: Static plots on the Run log & exports tab: initial and GraphBin binning plots side by side, drawn with the Configuration plot settings (DPI, width, height, vertex size, label size, image type PNG/SVG/PDF); Download GraphBin binning result plot (final_plot.png) and the initial plot's download.
steps: set the plot settings in the Configuration panel before running (defaults kept here)
run the refinement
scroll to Static plots and compare the two figures
press the download button under a plot
serves_tasks: View the before and after groupings side by side
Export the curated grouping, the raw outputs and a figure
